expected_before.stage: Future of Flight Phase 3 Project PORTAL grant
expected_before.note_en: Cambridge Sensoriis announced that it had been awarded a grant for Project PORTAL. The same announcement says PORTAL and ALIAS together are worth more than GBP500,000 to the business over two years, but it does not allocate an amount to either project, so the event amount is left undisclosed.

changed_fields.note_en: Cambridge Sensoriis Ltd (12586186), now trading as skyAnchor, is the exact recipient. Original UKRI GtR project 10023177 lists its own grant offer GBP406,593; this is neither consortium total nor project cost. Project funding approval/award is not proof of cash paid. Existing2022 public-year precision retained; exact day not established. The earlier joint more-than-GBP500k issuer headline is not imported as an additional event.

proposals.reason: Fresh official recipient-level grant offer resolves previously undisclosed PORTAL amount; do not create a duplicate event.

evidence.note: Exact Cambridge Sensoriis own grant offer GBP406,593, distinct from whole consortium.
